items.defectStatement: The shared mock occurrence builder discards `value`, so result and producer-call assertions cannot detect an incorrect value passed by the detector. Several expected occurrences consequently use 6 despite evaluated inputs of 10, 100, or 8.
obligations: Make different input values distinguishable by the tests' assertions.
Correct expected values to match the evaluated inputs, including both dedupe tests and the results-on-change test.
Preserve existing checks for priority, state transitions, deduplication, and occurrence production.
items.notes: Updating the helper alone either leaves assertions insensitive or exposes incorrect expectations outside the anchor. IssueOccurrence.__eq__ compares only id, so adding value to evidence_data alone is insufficient. This equality behavior and the direct evaluate_group_key_value input of 10 are absent from the frozen input.
